title: 호출벨
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie ballad. A nylon-string acoustic guitar plays a fingerstyle pattern with prominent fret noise and a warm, intimate tone. A male baritone vocal performs with a breathy, close-mic technique, utilizing a conversational delivery that shifts into a light head voice for higher melodic intervals. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the rhythmic guitar plucking and the vocal melody. The recording features a dry room acoustic with minimal artificial reverb. Tempo is 72 BPM in the key of G Major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerstyle nylon-string acoustic guitar]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
슬리퍼 끌리는 소리야
새벽 네 시 복도야
손을 씻고 있는데
비누 향이 났었어
내 손인지 몰라 환자 손인지 몰라
거울 속 얼굴이 누군지 모르겠어

[Chorus]
호출벨이 울려
아직도 울리는 거야
근무는 끝났는데
